evidence.note: Title slide: headline, subtitle and byline only; exempt.
Concept diagram of AI model, test environments and automated scorer, with one arrow drawn at step 0.
By step 5 the same diagram has gained more arrows (green and red reward paths with check marks) and a misaligned-reward callout, so it is built step by step.
Diagram of OpenAI servers and the public internet: an agent-run swarm fans into the package mirror, which has a key badge.
At step 7 the same diagram sits behind a timeline that has grown to five dated events, and an alert-off icon has appeared on the servers box.
The same persistent incident diagram carries over, now with a lock badge and a folder icon, beside a quote card.
By step 9 the diagram has evolved: coordinator nodes, red agents, a folder grid, an automated scorer and a 'never read transcripts' label.
Insights slide: three text tiles over the blurred diagram; this is an insight slide, so it is exempt.

rationale: Every non-exempt content slide in the evidence (s-2, s-4, s-5) is led by a diagram of its core concept that builds up step by step. The s-4 and s-5 diagrams are one persistent incident world that evolves across slides, which matches the pass anchor. The only text-led slides are the title, insights and close slides, which the pass descriptor exempts.
